title: Should a messy GTD request enter deliberation before execution?
original_request: Make GTD think deeply before it works.
desired_outcome: Reduce the chance that GTD executes a badly framed request while preserving fast execution for obvious work.
proposed_solution: Make every request go through deep contemplation.
current_framing: Use an activation router so deliberation is mandatory for high-risk or assumption-heavy work and bypassed for obvious low-risk work.

freshness_context.search_scope: Current portable agent packaging and skill standards relevant to the design
freshness_findings: Portable skills remain a suitable boundary for an optional deliberation layer.
freshness_gaps: Behavioral quality still requires model evals; standards conformance does not prove deliberation quality.

assumptions.statement: Mandatory deep contemplation on every request would add avoidable latency and analysis theater.
A separate pre-execution Skill can preserve the GTD core while adding deeper framing checks.

evidence.claim: The GTD core already routes only the current blocker instead of running every mode.
Portable skill packaging supports focused skills with their own references and scripts.

contradictions: The original proposal made contemplation universal, while GTD's existing architecture values the smallest mode needed for the current blocker.
alternative_framings: Replace GTD direct execution entirely with contemplation.
Add a deliberation preflight only when framing risk is material.
Keep GTD unchanged and rely on user prompting for deeper thought.
second_order_effects: A universal contemplation requirement could slow trivial tasks.
A separate Problem Model creates durable decision provenance before implementation.

candidate_directions.summary: Mandatory deep deliberation for every GTD request
candidate_directions.rationale: Strongest consistency but highest analysis overhead.
candidate_directions.verification_path: Compare behavioral evals and task latency.

candidate_directions.rationale: Adds deep challenge where framing error matters while preserving direct execution elsewhere.

recommended_direction.why: It preserves GTD's directness while adding evidence-backed challenge for high-risk framing.

rejected_directions.summary: Mandatory deep deliberation for every request
rejected_directions.reason: It violates the smallest-useful-mode principle and can reward analysis volume over information value.

direction_gate.decision: Adopt risk-triggered deliberation with mandatory current-date freshness search when activated.

contemplation_exit.reason: The framing, trade-offs, and implementation direction are sufficiently established to plan bounded work.
remaining_uncertainty: Behavioral eval scores have not yet been executed against multiple models.
